payload.reason: The evidence clearly outlines the main motivation of the paper, which is to provide a method for annotating grammatical error correction data with error type information, facilitating better evaluation and feedback.

claims.text: The main aim of the paper is to rectify the lack of error type analysis in GEC systems by providing a method to automatically annotate parallel error correction data with error type information.
The paper introduces ERRANT, a toolkit designed to facilitate detailed error type evaluation and standardize existing error correction corpora.
ERRANT is the only toolkit capable of producing error type scores, addressing a gap in GEC evaluation tools.
